name: High Protein Muesli
ingredients: Whole Grains (34%) (Rolled Oats, Ragi Flakes, Jowar Flakes, Quinoa Flakes, Brown Rice Flakes); Protein Blend (24%) {Texturized Soy Protein, Soy Protein Isolate}; Dry Fruits, Nuts & Seeds (22%) (Black Raisin, Cranberry, Almonds, Flax Seeds, Pumpkin Seeds); Organic Jaggery, Cocoa Powder (7%), Dates, Rice Bran Oil, Himalayan Pink Salt.
